Overview.Name: Endarapu Rajitha
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating

Meal_1: Option 2: Poha (rice poha) (1 medium bowl ~1.5 cups cooked)
Option 3: Curd rice (small bowl cooked rice & curd & salt)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (simple) & curd (small cup)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (pan-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Cooked rice (smaller portion) & vegetable curry (simple) & curd (small cup)
Meal_3: Option 1: Paneer (pan-grilled) & small bowl cooked rice

Notes_and_Tips: Because you lose control once you start eating: serve one fixed portion and wait 10 minutes before taking more.
Sweet cravings: keep fruit or buttermilk first; avoid sweets late night.
As Meals are two keep lunch as your strongest meal (dal/paneer & curd), and keep dinner lighter and earlier (soup/1 chapati/buttermilk).
Stress trigger: before meals, drink a glass of water and do 10 slow breaths; it reduces fast eating and helps portion control.
Walking daily (20–30 mins) supports energy and appetite control.
Bedtime (optional): warm turmeric milk (small cup, no sugar) or warm water.
SIMS / nutrition theory note: protein-first meals and steady timing improve satiety and stable energy.
